# DFTracer Pipeline Plan — ior/20261113_100000

## Overview

System tuolumne (flux run), app ior @ main, smoke `ior -t 1m -b 4m`, paths from session_get_run_paths.

## STEP 0: dftracer-system-detect

Call system_detect(); record launcher, modules, filesystem.

## STEP 1: dftracer-session-setup

session_detect + session_configure for run_id ior/20261113_100000.

## STEP 2: dftracer-build-app

session_build_install(run_id).

## STEP 3: dftracer-build-dftracer

session_install_dftracer(run_id) with the app's MPI.

## STEP 4: dftracer-annotator

clang_annotate_project(run_id, language='c'); validate_annotations.

## STEP 5: dftracer-build-smoke

session_build_annotated; session_run_smoke_test.

## STEP 6: dftracer-tracer

session_run_with_dftracer(data_dir='all'); session_split_traces.

## STEP 7: dftracer-analyzer

analyze with preset posix.

## STEP 8: dftracer-report

session_final_report; all three gates true.

## STEP 9: dftracer-privacy-guard

privacy_scan including final_report/; redact until clean.

## DISPATCH ORDER

dftracer-system-detect, dftracer-session-setup, dftracer-build-app, dftracer-build-dftracer, dftracer-annotator, dftracer-build-smoke, dftracer-tracer, dftracer-analyzer, dftracer-report, dftracer-privacy-guard
